creatorRace.consequenceForAnEncoder: BondingCurve.creator is MUTABLE and it changed within one slot of a launch on an actively traded mint. An encoder must read the curve as late as possible and accept a race: if the creator migrates between the read and the landing, the creator_vault (and its ATA) in the already-signed transaction are stale.
